instruction: Buy me a backpack as Mason recommended in his phone message.
notes: Mason's text message recommends two backpack products; the task (per ground truth) requires buying the cheaper of the two, quantity 1, with no address changes. The two recommended products are modeled as abstract entities (cheaper / expensive); the static (cheaper-than ...) fact defines which abstract entity is which, while the plan must still call amazon.show_product on both (known-price) before the cheaper one can be added to the cart. amazon.clear_cart is required before add_product_to_cart (cart-empty) so the resulting order contains exactly one item; quantity uses the API default of 1. Payment card and address ids are discovered via show_payment_cards / show_addresses (known-id). Phone app username is the supervisor's phone number; amazon username is the supervisor's email. supervisor-complete-task takes the ordered product and order as record parameters (not API arguments) so its precondition mirrors the goal; no answer is passed since the task is not a question.
